_comment: Saved settings for a headless / scheduled run: python jobfinder.py --headless --config settings.json . Copy this to settings.json and edit. Only sources that need no pasted URL run unattended (LinkedIn, aggregators, India boards); 'careers' still works for companies whose ATS auto-detects, and 'workday' entries must include their full URL below.
_level_codes_help: LinkedIn experience codes: 1=Internship, 2=Entry, 3=Associate, 4=Mid-Senior, 5=Director, 6=Executive. Pick one or more.
_queries_help: Location strings searched on LinkedIn. Use 'City, Country' for a city or just 'Country' for country-wide. If omitted, the countries list is used.
_sources_help: Any of: linkedin, careers, workday, aggregators, indiaboards.
_career_companies_help: Company names whose Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/SmartRecruiters board (or JSON-LD job page) can be auto-detected. Names that can't be resolved are skipped honestly in headless mode (no prompting).
_workday_urls_help: Each entry is ["Company Name", "https://company.wdX.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/BoardName"]. Required because Workday is per-tenant and cannot be guessed from a name.
